rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0001
rows.name:
You know that pair of Blades who were
hunting Core Crystals, right?

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0002
rows.name:
I heard that with new Drivers, they've
turned over a new leaf and are doing
the right thing now.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0003
rows.name:
If they're not evil any more,
I'd kind of like to meet them.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0004
rows.name:
I want to see what kind of people made
my older brother in the Superbian
Military Engineer Corps suffer.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm...sorry for running
my mouth off like that.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0007
rows.name:
You really do seem like good people.
I can feel your sincerity.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0008
rows.name:
I guess it's true that Blades are
strongly affected by their Drivers.

rows.label: tlk45300021_06_msg0009
rows.name:
You two were lucky to meet such good
Drivers.
